title.en: My five senses at the pasar

en: We have five senses. They help us learn about the world. Let's take them to the pasar!
I see with my eyes. I see red chillies and green kangkung.
I hear with my ears. I hear a seller call, 'Fresh fish! Fresh fish!'
I smell with my nose. I smell sweet, ripe mangoes.
I touch with my hands. The rambutan feels hairy and soft.
I taste with my tongue. Ibu buys me a kue lapis. Mmm, sweet!
id: Kita punya lima indra. Indra membantu kita mengenal dunia. Ayo bawa semuanya ke pasar!
Aku melihat dengan mata. Aku melihat cabai merah dan kangkung hijau.
Aku mendengar dengan telinga. Aku mendengar penjual berseru, 'Ikan segar! Ikan segar!'
Aku mencium dengan hidung. Aku mencium mangga matang yang harum.
Aku meraba dengan tangan. Rambutan terasa berbulu dan lembut.
Aku mengecap dengan lidah. Ibu membelikanku kue lapis. Hmm, manis!

objectives.en: Names the five senses and the body part used for each.
objectives.id: Menyebut lima indra dan bagian tubuh untuk masing-masing.

objectives.en: Reads a simple pattern text with support.
objectives.id: Membaca teks berpola sederhana dengan bantuan.

meaning.en: the ways our body notices the world: seeing, hearing, smelling, touching and tasting
meaning.id: cara tubuh mengenal dunia: melihat, mendengar, mencium, meraba, dan mengecap

meaning.en: new and not old or stale

prompt.en: What is this book mostly about?

en: using our five senses at the market

prompt.en: If you closed your eyes at the pasar, how could you tell a motorbike was coming?
prompt.id: Jika kamu menutup mata di pasar, bagaimana kamu tahu ada motor datang?

en: by listening for its engine with your ears

connection.en: Our senses collect information about the world around us.
connection.id: Indra mengumpulkan informasi tentang dunia di sekitar kita.

connection.en: A traditional Indonesian market is full of sights, sounds and smells.
connection.id: Pasar tradisional penuh warna, suara, dan aroma.

discussionPrompts.en: Which sense do you use most at the market?
discussionPrompts.id: Indra mana yang paling sering kamu pakai di pasar?
Bau apa yang paling kamu suka?

offlineActivity.en: At home, play a senses game: your child closes their eyes and guesses three kitchen things by smell (a lime, a slice of ginger, a cup of tea) and by touch. Only taste foods the adult offers.
offlineActivity.id: Di rumah, mainkan permainan indra: anak menutup mata dan menebak tiga benda dapur lewat bau (jeruk nipis, irisan jahe, secangkir teh) dan rabaan. Hanya cicipi makanan yang diberikan orang dewasa.

factChecks.claim: People are usually taught to have five senses: sight, hearing, smell, touch and taste.
We see with our eyes, hear with our ears, smell with our nose, touch with our skin and taste with our tongue.

safetyNotes.en: Check for food allergies before tasting, and let the adult prepare and slice any food.
safetyNotes.id: Periksa alergi makanan sebelum mencicipi, dan biarkan orang dewasa yang menyiapkan dan mengiris makanan.

safetyNotes.en: Keep hot tea out of reach; let it cool before your child smells it.
safetyNotes.id: Jauhkan teh panas dari jangkauan; biarkan dingin dulu sebelum dicium anak.
